subject: Quantix Spotlight: Video Testimonial — schedule & consent

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Quantix Spotlight: Video Testimonial — schedule & consent

Hi Sana —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer spotlight with us. We think a 3–4 minute on-camera testimonial featuring your Head of Product would be perfect to highlight how Quantix uses Redwood Inference for production latency-sensitive workloads.

High-level ask: could we do a 2–3 hour shoot at your San Francisco office the week of Nov 16? Prefer either Wed 11/18 or Fri 11/20 midday. Our vendor, BrightFrame Studios, will handle capture and basic lighting. We’ll provide a short script and talking points in advance.

Logistics we need from you:
- Confirm preferred shoot date/time (11/18 or 11/20).
- Point person for onsite coordination and security/visitor access.
- Legal contact for the release form (we’ll share DocuSign).

We’ll send a draft release form, a run-of-show, and a short list of talking points by end of day today. If you prefer a remote interview instead, we can also do a polished Zoom-based recording.

Thanks — excited to feature Quantix’s story.

— Evelyn Hart
Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn —

Fantastic — we’re happy to move forward. 11/20 midday works best for us (we have a product review on 11/18). I’m looping in our marketing lead and BrightFrame so they can coordinate details.

On logistics:
- Point person: me (Sana) — I’ll handle visitor badges and a nearby meeting room.
- Legal: Maria Gomez (cc’d on a separate thread) is our go-to for release signoffs; she’ll need the DocuSign link.

Please send the release and the run-of-show. We’d like to review and return the signed release by EOD 11/17 if possible. Also happy to share a brief briefing doc about our messaging priorities.

Best,

- Rafael: please finalize the shoot-day call sheet and equipment list; BrightFrame will drive but we should confirm mic/backup recorder and a short B-roll list. (Due 11/13)
- Marissa: draft a 90–120s script + 4 talking points that align with the Quantix pitch they mentioned (latency, cost predictability, ease of deployment). Keep it interview-friendly — bullets, not paragraphs. (Due 11/13)

- Sean: I'll need a final list of internal approvers for the final cut and the name for the lower-third title.

We should attach the release form and a preliminary call sheet when we reply to Quantix. I’ll take point to send DocuSign.

(Early note: BrightFrame asked if we have any restrictions on product screenshots or customer PII in the demo. Rafael — flag anything sensitive.)

— Evelyn
